message.content:
Below is a quick‑look at the **federal public holidays** that create “official” long weekends in Canada for 2023.  
(If you’re planning trips in a specific province, you’ll want to add that province’s own holidays – many of them fall on the same dates, but a few differ.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Long Weekend? | Notes |
|-------------|---------|-------------|---------------|-------|
| Jan 1 | New Year’s Day | Sunday | **No** (but many people take Monday off) | |
| Feb 20 | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, etc.) | Monday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Mon‑Tue) |
| Apr 7 | Good Friday | Friday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sun) |
| May 22 | Victoria Day | Monday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Mon‑Tue) |
| Jul 1 | Canada Day | Saturday | **No** (but many people take Sunday off) | |
| Aug 7 | Civic Holiday (Ontario) | Monday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Mon‑Tue) |
| Sep 4 | Labour Day | Monday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Mon‑Tue) |
| Oct 9 | Thanksgiving | Monday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Mon‑Tue) |
| Nov 11 | Remembrance Day | Wednesday | **No** | |
| Dec 25 | Christmas Day | Monday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Mon‑Tue) |
| Dec 26 | Boxing Day | Tuesday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Mon‑Tue) |

### How to use this in your app

1. **Store the dates** in a database or JSON file.  
2. **Flag the “Long Weekend” column** so you can filter or highlight them.  
3. If you want to support provincial holidays, add a separate table per province and merge on the date.

### Quick reference for provincial variations

| Province | Extra Holiday | Date (2023) | Long Weekend? |
|----------|---------------|-------------|---------------|
| British Columbia | Family Day | Feb 20 | Yes |
| Saskatchewan | Family Day | Feb 20 | Yes |
| Manitoba | Louis Riel Day | Feb 20 | Yes |
| Quebec | Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day | Jun 24 | No (but many take adjacent days off) |
| Newfoundland & Labrador | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 | No |
| ... | ... | ... | ... |

*(Full lists can be found on each province’s government website.)*

Feel free to let me know if you’d like a more detailed breakdown for a particular province or if you need help formatting this data for your holiday‑planning app!
